summary:
A 15-wide, 2-storey rough-stone farmhouse (x1..15, z11..19) with a steep red-tile roof, brick chimney (top y14), warped-green shuttered windows and a dark-oak lean-to porch on its east side. Beside it, through a lantern-lit gate on the porch axis, lies a walled symmetrical potager (x20..38, z4..32): four timber-edged raised beds with wheat/carrot/potato/beetroot rows, gravel+brick paths crossing at a roofed well, rose arches, espaliered fruit trees, a glasshouse, cold frame and tool shed.
Build as 6 parts (shell, porch+openings, potager, features, interior, grounds). vocab.mjs holds the layout, an OPENINGS table and tested helpers; the roof is a make.sh `mcd roof` cottage-preset step.

farmhouse shell: Farmhouse shell complete: 534 wall/floor/partition blocks + 356 roof blocks. Rough stone walls with stone brick quoins at corners, two storeys, brick chimney breast, all opening gaps left unset for later parts. Structure sound and ready for next worker to add windows, doors, porch, and potager.
